content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family and attached homes to individual buyers through its own sales centers, with mortgage services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes directly to homebuyers, with in-house mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Sells finished lots to homebuilders as a B2B land developer, not building and selling homes to consumers."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with affiliated mortgage financing."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells detached and attached homes, including active adult, to consumers with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with affiliated mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family and townhomes to individual buyers, with affiliated mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Insurance underwriter selling title, mortgage guaranty and property-casualty policies to lenders and businesses, not building homes."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Life insurer that also runs cemeteries and mortuaries; homebuilding is absent and its mortgage lending is a minor separate line."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Diversified landholder running hotels, clubs, restaurants and timber; it sells some homes but is not a homebuilder."}]}
